# Method: line crops at 1.3x, with 2.2x-3x zooms on doubtful numbers and on the right-hand page edge.
# Notation:
#   numbers are written space-separated; the manuscript's dots and spaces between numbers are not reproduced
#   ?        after a number: unsure of the reading
#   [a/b]    two possible readings
#   ^        small mark above or after a number (tick, caret, flourish clearly separate from the digits)
#   °        small circle above / after a number
#   _+       small cross (or star) below the number
#   _v       small tick below the number
#   ~        a short stray stroke or dash standing between numbers (not a number)
#   [clipped] number cut off at the page / film edge (visible leading digits given before it)
#   [illegible] number present but not readable
#   english words inside a run are copied in place in lower case
# General notes:
#   - 1385 very often ends with a raised flourish on the 5; it is not marked ^ unless clearly separate.
#   - In this hand 7 has a long descender (looks like j) and 9 has a closed loop; 6 often looks like a delta.
#     The pair 5/8 (an S-like glyph) and the thin 1 versus small 0 are the commonest doubts.
#   - Underlining in the manuscript is noted at line end.
